models.loss: Stored rows do not establish complete watch point-session link/source identity or boundary certainty; summaries are derived, not replacement raw records.

capture.native: CLLocationManager desiredAccuracyBest, defaultdistanceFilter5m, backgroundupdates=true/automaticpause=false; opt-in start monitors CLVisit/significantchange/continuousupdates; Stop ends session and stops all3, ends Live Activities, clears tracking default. Always/WhenInUse authorization handled natively, cannot grant through CLI.
capture.restore: Persisted tracking/distancefilter/stopafter/LiveActivity defaults, active session ID and open-session reconciliation; startup resumes if enabled+permission. Auto-stop timer uses wall-clock elapsed and remaining seconds. No uninterrupted forced-quit/reboot/clock/callback guarantee from source.
capture.quality_compatibility: Phone point save accepts horizontalAccuracy[0,100]m; outlier impliedspeed>40m/s or paired spikes>100m with endpointgap<30m. Raw flags retain suspect points; rejected accuracy rows unavailable. This is donor compatibility, not a universal coarse-location policy.
capture.boundary: distantPast arrival/distantFuture departure CLVisit sentinels; later arrival closes old visits; open-visit reconciliation infers departure from next arrival/fallback date; duplicate merge deletes redundant rows. Must preserve unknown lineage/certainty rather than fabricate raw facts.
